info.description: Tech stack section: full-width hover rows, either paginated with a Show more/less toggle or listed in full with a CTA button

anchor.description: DOM id / URL hash for this section (e.g. "technologies" → #technologies). Lets nav links target this section on the page.

showMore.description: Show a set number of technologies behind a Show more/less toggle (labels + count editable), or list every picked technology

button.description: Only available when Show more/less is switched off — the button and the toggle are mutually exclusive
